mapper.sql: SELECT sys09_code AS cd , sys09_name AS nm FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = '${kind}' AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND sys09_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) ) AND sys09_apply_date <= f_today() AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_close_date >= f_today() ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) )
